plain: A person who secretly plans a wrong act with others.

webster.text: One who conspires; one who engages in a plot to commit a crime, particularly treason.

example.quote: In Vermont, the conspirators assembled in arms, but were suppressed by the exertions of the militia, under the direction of their sheriffs.
example.cite: Letters of Agrippa I-XI, Massachusetts Gazette, Nov. 1787-Jan. 1788
